text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day. Since Gold City is so popular, I went to check on her out of concern that it might be a hectic day, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Trainer.
Whatcha doing?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Is it bad if I came empty-handed?
choice_data_list: I thought you might've gotten chocolates or something.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I see.
A Valentine's gift.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I've received plenty.
Specifically, plenty of 'Happy Valentine's' wishes.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yep. This year, I asked them to turn down physical gifts,
even from students at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"When combined with what I get from fans,
it turns into a massive amount every year."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Everyone tries to be thoughtful and gives me non-food stuff like accessories or cosmetics, but you just can't use it all up, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So this year—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
City-san!
Happy Valentine's Day!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I got your feelings loud and clear.
Happy Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaah! T-Thank you so much~~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Those are the kinds of words
she leaves for me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Being able to talk face-to-face
makes me happier, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: So, you've got nothing?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If you just came here to tease me, I'm leaving.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, hearing that from you
feels super weird.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, are you actually putting feeling into that?
Do you even realize you're the present?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if it's nothing, that's fine.
I mean, it's not something I can force on you anyway.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Forget it. You praised me so much,
I feel like I'm getting ahead of myself—"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...!
Your voice is so loud...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
This isn't a contest to see who can shout the loudest, you know.
Still... well, I guess my feelings got through to her.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Well, from me too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...So, did you just come here
to tease me?"
choice_data_list: It's not that I'm teasing, I was just worried.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No matter how you look at it, don't you
think I'm way more used to this kinda stuff?
choice_data_list: I figured, that was none of my business...
I thought so, that was none of my business...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Still, this worked out nicely.
Come over here for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Here, Happy Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Consider this a token of my gratitude for looking after me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
What are you so scared of?
By the way, inside is a skincare set.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I included several different brands for you to try,
so let me know which one suits you best.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then I'll gift you a full set so you can use the whole line. I can even check it for you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Why've you been acting so intimidated?
Is it really that weird for me to do something for you?
choice_data_list: It's not weird at all! I'm really happy!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: If you say so.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Like I said earlier,
you've done a lot for me, after all."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I've been causing quite a bit of worry, after all.
I don't think this alone makes up for it, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well... so, basically,
just for now, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you actually try it, okay?
I'll know right away if you didn't. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Seriously, you're always so quick to answer, but...
